hero:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for CodeMap.
Input image is an IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: its first row shows the hero's four directions. Create a NEW transparent animation sheet of that SAME hero, preserving face, chestnut hair, teal cloak hood down, cream tunic, boots, leather belt/satchel and wooden staff. Preserve low-poly faceted diorama rendering and warm upper-left light. NOT a redesign.
Output one landscape 3:2 PNG, ideally 1536x1024, exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows. NO labels, text, grid lines, platforms, shadows outside cells or background. Genuine alpha transparency. Each sprite entirely inside its own equal cell, centered horizontally, feet aligned to the same baseline at 88% cell height, same head/body size in every cell, generous padding.
Row1 faces down/front; row2 up/back; row3 left; row4 right. Camera and direction remain IDENTICAL across a row.
Each row contains six frames in this order: column1 idle neutral eyes open, column2 idle gentle breathing and blink (same planted feet), column3 walking contact left foot forward/right back, column4 walking passing pose left leg under body/right knee raised, column5 walking opposite contact right foot forward/left back, column6 walking opposite passing pose. Staff held consistently, cloak shifts subtly with the stride. Walk frames MUST visibly differ in leg/foot positions, with alternating steps rather than six near-identical standing poses. One frame per cell, exactly 24 sprites. No duplicate extra characters or scenery. Match the supplied hero reference identity closely.
